For the fiscal year 2025, the Company recorded a
gross profit of 143.5 million baht, a decrease of 137.3
million baht, or 48.9%, compared to the same period
of the previous year. The gross profit margin was
10.9%, compared to 19.7% in the prior year, 
The decline was primarily due to the development of a
new production line, which resulted in higher fixed
costs, along with a slight decrease in sales revenue.
Nevertheless, the Company remains focused on cost
control, product development to better meet
consumer demand, and the expansion of distribution
channels both domestically and internationally to
enhance operational efficiency.FY2025

For the fiscal year 2025, SG&A expenses totaled 229.4
million baht, representing an increase of 5.2% from the
previous year. The change was primarily driven by
continued marketing and promotional activities for new
products, increased research and development costs,
investments in human resource development, and
higher depreciation and inventory-related provisions.
The Company maintained effective cost management
to align expenses with sales performance and support
operational efficiency.FY2025
